# ItemDef

> Item definition registry: what every item or decoration is.

- Package: `ItemDef` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("ItemDef")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("ItemDef")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.ItemDef`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/ItemDefinitionService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local ItemDef = GaxiaServer.ItemDef
```

### Functions

- `ItemDef.Register(id: string, def: { [string]: any }): ()`
  Register one definition. `id` is stamped onto a defensive copy so callers can't later mutate the stored table by reference.
- `ItemDef.RegisterMany(map: { [string]: { [string]: any } }): ()`
  Register a whole `{ [id] = def }` map at once (boot-time bulk load).
- `ItemDef.Get(id: string): ItemDef?`
- `ItemDef.Has(id: string): boolean`
- `ItemDef.GetField(id: string, field: string, default: any): any`
  A field read with a fallback default so consumers don't nil-check every access.
- `ItemDef.GetAll(): { [string]: ItemDef }`
  Shallow copy of the registry so callers can't mutate internal state.
- `ItemDef.GetByCategory(category: string): { ItemDef }`
- `ItemDef.GetByRarity(rarity: string): { ItemDef }`
- `ItemDef.Count(): number`
